description: The headboard width for a bed size (2 to 4 inches wider than the mattress), the typical height above the mattress, the height from the floor, and whether the wall leaves room for nightstands beside it. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

top.description: Floor to the top of the mattress in inches. Optional.

wall.description: Width of the wall behind the bed in feet. Optional: leave out to skip the nightstand check.
